title: Brick Plaza
description: Hang out in a blocky town with a fountain, cafe, hat shop, arcade, a two-story house, playground slides, a trampoline, a pool and a stage. Show off emotes, sit on benches, grab a snack and play Tag with friends or bots as day turns to night.
controls: WASD move, Space jump, drag to look, E interact, 1-4 emotes (wave, dance, cheer, sit)
